name: 10,000 Roses
description: Cordova waterfront garden of roughly 10,000 LED-lit white roses beside Lantaw Floating Restaurant in Day-as.
overview: 10,000 Roses Cafe & More fills a Day-as waterfront garden with white acrylic roses that light up after dusk, making it a popular photo stop beside the Mactan Channel. By day the flowers look like plain white stems; the LED display typically switches on around 6 PM, so late afternoon is the best time to visit. The site includes a small cafe and souvenir store, and weekend evenings can be busy with local families and pre-nuptial shoots. Published opening times conflict, so message the official Facebook page before a long drive.
highlights: LED rose garden lit after dusk
address: Day-as Barangay Road, Barangay Day-as, Cordova, Cebu 6017 (Cordova Tourism Center compound)
openingHours: Unverified: published hours conflict; confirm on the official Facebook page
closingHours: Unverified: published hours conflict; confirm on the official Facebook page
entranceFee: ₱20 per person; ₱10 seniors/PWD with ID; parking ₱20-₱30 (confirm at gate)
locationNote: Existing map pins can differ by about 50 m. The roses only glow after dark; daytime visits are often underwhelming. Cash and GCash are reported, but cards may not be accepted.

name: Solea Mactan Resort
description: Large family resort and waterpark in Alegria with eight pools, themed suites and a private beach.
overview: Solea Mactan Resort is a family-oriented beachfront property whose main draws are eight swimming pools, including the Kim and Kath infinity pools, and an inflatable waterpark. Themed suites such as Brick Builders, Neverland, Lost Chambers and Dino Discovery make it especially popular with younger guests, while the Happy Pebbles Club, spa and gym cater to the rest of the family. Facility hours differ by pool, and day-use is sold as a package rather than a simple entrance ticket, so confirm current inclusions directly with the resort.
highlights: Eight pools including Kim and Kath infinity pools
address: Victor Wahing Street, Barangay Alegria, Cordova, Cebu 6017
openingHours: 8:00 AM (day-use; hotel front desk operates 24 hours)
closingHours: 5:00 PM day-use; pool and waterpark hours vary

locationNote: Verify which pools and waterpark features are open on arrival; maintenance closures are commonly reported. Present a day-use voucher and valid ID at the front desk.

name: Bantayan Beach
description: Municipal white-sand sandbar off Bantayan with mangroves, floating cottages and tide-dependent access.
overview: Bantayan Bay is a shallow white-sand sandbar just off Cordova's shore, bordered by mangroves and lined with privately operated floating cottages. At low tide a sand bridge appears and visitors can walk out; at high tide a short bangka ride is needed. The area reopened in 2023 after water-quality testing, and the municipality has set swimming hours and prohibited alcohol, smoking, glass containers, loud speakers, camping and grilling outside provided stations. Do not confuse it with Bantayan Island in northern Cebu.
highlights: White sandbar and shallow turquoise water
About 45 minutes from Mactan-Cebu International Airport
address: Sitio Bantayan, Barangay Catarman / Poblacion, Cordova, Cebu 6017 (Bantayan Port access)

locationNote: Navigate by 'Bantayan Port' rather than the old app pin. Swimming is tide-dependent, and the beach has a history of closure for high coliform; check current municipal notices before swimming.

name: Cordova Reef Village Resort
description: Seaside bungalow resort at the southeastern tip of Bantayan with direct beach access and an outdoor pool.
overview: Cordova Reef Village Resort is a long-running Filipino-owned beach property with garden and ocean villas, an al fresco restaurant and direct access to the Bantayan shoreline. Reviews describe a relaxed, older-style resort beside the Bantayan Bay public beach area, with a pool that was reopened in 2026 after renovation. Published day-use rates and contact numbers vary across sources, so confirm current arrangements by phone or through the official Facebook page before booking.

name: Agila Resort
description: Budget pool resort in Alegria set among large coconut trees, with cottages, a cafe and pet-friendly grounds.
overview: Mactan Agila Resort is a low-cost day-use and overnight getaway with a pool, cottages, cabanas, tents and Cafe Plumeria, set among large coconut trees in Barangay Alegria. It allows bring-your-own food and drinks, with a reported ₱300 corkage for lechon, and is pet-friendly. Rates and hours in public listings date from 2020-2024 and sometimes conflict with an older, unrelated Agila Resort & Spa, so confirm the current property and details before travelling.

name: Villa Asela Resort
description: Budget garden resort in Bangbang with three pools, a waterslide, cottages and function halls near Mactan airport.
overview: Villa Asela is an inland family day-use and events resort on Bang-bang Barangay Road, about 4 miles from Mactan-Cebu International Airport. It has three pools, including a 4-foot youth pool with a waterslide, plus videoke, a canteen, a playground, day cottages and function or conference halls. Budget rooms and a RedDoorz property operate in the same compound, and an on-site restaurant soft-opened in 2026. Entrance-fee reports conflict across older posts, so confirm the current rate by phone.

name: Alta Hotel
description: Garden resort and events hotel in Pilipog with mural-painted rooms, two pools and function spaces near CCLEX.
overview: Alta Cebu Resort, listed in older directories as Alta Hotel, sits in a seven-acre garden in Pilipog close to the CCLEX. Rooms feature hand-painted murals by local artists, and the property has two outdoor pools, a poolside bar, Bagon Cafe, indoor function rooms and outdoor event areas for weddings, conferences and trainings. Current booking listings show a 2025 renovation, a spa and a 24-hour front desk, but no public day-use schedule is published.

name: Lantaw Restaurant
description: Floating Filipino seafood restaurant at Sa Baybayon in Day-as, facing the Mactan Channel beside 10,000 Roses.
overview: Lantaw Cordova serves Filipino and Cebuano grilled seafood from an open-air wooden-and-bamboo floating platform at Sa Baybayon. After Typhoon Odette it reopened in June 2022 on a smaller platform beside the original bridge, with views of the Mactan Channel, 10,000 Roses Cafe and the CCLEX. Popular orders include grilled fish cooked sutukil-style, baked scallops, tinolang manok and fruit shakes. Published hours conflict, so check the official Facebook page or a current map listing before going.

name: Parola Restaurant
description: Open-air Filipino seafood restaurant at the Cordova RORO port, known for sunset deck dining beside a lighthouse landmark.
overview: Parola Seaview is the original branch of Creative Cuisine Group's lighthouse-themed seafood restaurant, beside the Cordova RORO port at the southwest tip of Mactan. Its waterfront deck is known for sunset views and Filipino and Cebuano staples such as bilao platters, crispy pata, grilled bangus, baked scallops and garlic rice. The chain also has Naga Boardwalk and Danao branches, so check the branch name when navigating.

name: Sungka Native Restaurant
description: Native Filipino restaurant in Day-as with dining tables surrounding a large koi pond.
overview: Sungka Native Restaurant is a 'Dine by the Pond' venue on Day-as Barangay Road, across from RR Dress Shop and before 10,000 Roses Cafe. Tables surround a large koi pond, and the menu covers Filipino comfort food and seafood such as pork BBQ, sinigang na baboy, scallops, guso and halo-halo. Current operator-post mirrors and map listings give 11 AM to 10 PM daily, but older sources disagree, so treat the opening time as unverified.

name: Bakasihan
description: Open-air seafood eatery at Kampay Beach famous for linarang na bakasi and featured on Netflix's Street Food: Asia.
overview: Cordova's muddy tidal flats sustain reef eels, and this self-service carinderia has served linarang na bakasi for decades, earning a place in Netflix's Street Food: Asia Cebu episode. The signature dish stews small eels with fermented black beans, green mango, tamarind and native chili; the counter also offers kinhason, adobong nokos, guso, swaki, grilled fish and crabs. Dining is under fans with sea views and no air-conditioning, and bakasi often sells out by early afternoon.

name: Bric Food Park
description: Open-air container-style food park near Gaisano Grand Cordova with Filipino and Asian street-food stalls and live music.
overview: BRIC is an open-air, container-style food park about two minutes from Gaisano Grand Mall, made up of multiple stalls rather than a single restaurant. Vendors cover Filipino barbecue and sisig, Korean dishes, burgers, jumbo corn dogs, milk teas and fruit shakes, with live acoustic sets and open-mic nights. It is mainly an evening venue; reviewers mention a parking fee and weekend parking spillover onto the road.

name: Roro Port Food Park
description: Municipal waterfront food plaza at Cordova RORO Port with about 50 vendors selling grilled seafood and street food.
overview: The Municipality of Cordova opened the RORO Port Food Plaza in June 2025 to support local vendors and attract visitors. The plaza caps participation at about 50 vendors, issues uniforms and provides trash bins and portalets; stalls sell grilled seafood, pungko-pungko, kinilaw, tuslob buwa, lechon, kwek-kwek and milk tea. It runs along the Cordova-RORO Port Baywalk, with sunset views and sightlines of the CCLEX. Hours are not officially published and come from secondary posts.

name: Gilutongan Island
description: Island barangay and pioneer marine protected area off southern Cordova known for a coral drop-off wall, snorkeling and diving.
overview: Gilutongan, also spelled Hilutungan, is an island barangay off southern Cordova and one of Central Visayas' pioneer marine protected areas. The community-managed reserve has clear water, coral gardens, a steep drop-off wall and reef fish such as sea turtles, batfish, parrotfish and giant trevallies. Most visitors take a registered bangka from Bantayan Wharf or Day-as Port; snorkeling is done in designated zones from the boat because boats cannot dock at the sanctuary. Trips are tide- and weather-dependent.

name: Cebu-Cordova Link Expressway (CCLEX)
description: 8.9-km toll cable-stayed bridge linking Cebu City's SRP to Cordova, with a free pedestrian and cycling lane.
overview: CCLEX is an 8.9-km toll expressway opened in 2022 that links Cebu City's South Road Properties to Barangay Pilipog in Cordova. Its 390-m cable-stayed span crosses the Mactan Channel with 51 m of shipping clearance, and its two 145-m pylons carry eight lit crosses inspired by Magellan's Cross Pavilion. The route was aligned around mangroves, and a separated pedestrian and cycling lane entered from the Cordova side is free. Vehicle tolls reached full approved levels in October 2025; lane hours and same-day changes are posted on the official Facebook page.
